summary.business_type: Publisher / Amazon-affiliate review site (headphones & microphones) — post-remediation re-audit
top_findings: Health score 51 -> 66 after this session's fixes; gains concentrated in Technical, On-Page, Schema, GEO
Performance unchanged (38): hotlinked Unsplash, no WebP, CDN HTML uncacheable (AAWP cookic) — biggest remaining lever
Content/E-E-A-T unchanged (54): no first-hand testing evidence or author photo — #1 ranking lever for an affiliate review site
Comparison spec tables still absent on 'vs' posts (0 <table>) despite strong comparison content
Minor cleanup open: homepage 2x H1, llms.txt 404, author archive indexed, 3 year-slug duplicates, 42 empty categories
quick_wins: Fix AAWP-cookie CDN caching in Hostinger (DYNAMIC->HIT, cut TTFB)
Add spec comparison tables to 'vs' posts (featured-snippet/AI lever)
Reduce homepage to a single descriptive H1
Publish /llms.txt; noindex or enrich the author archive
Decide canonical for the 3 remaining -2026-2 duplicate slugs

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Indexable URLs 674 -> 356; indexed tags 310 -> 10; ~20 duplicate posts 301'd + trashed
Full security header set (HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy)
X-Powered-By removed; xmlrpc.php 403; REST user + ?author=N enumeration blocked
Clean canonicalisation, valid sitemaps, server-rendered HTML

findings.title: Homepage still has two H1 ('Home' + hero)
findings.description:
Theme/Elementor renders

Home

plus the hero H1.
findings.recommendation: Suppress the templated title H1; keep one descriptive H1.

findings.title: Author archive still indexed
findings.description: /author/peter_froggatt/ returns 200, indexable (enumeration is blocked, but the archive itself remains).
findings.recommendation: Noindex the author archive or enrich it for E-E-A-T.

findings.title: Render-blocking JS/CSS + image dimensions (CWV lab)
findings.recommendation: Defer jQuery, critical CSS, set image dimensions.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Two-layer FTC disclosure; transparent /how-we-choose/; readable; thin tag/duplicate pages now removed

findings.title: No first-hand testing evidence in affiliate roundups
findings.description: Unchanged — roundups still rely on Amazon/manufacturer copy; no original photos/impressions.
findings.recommendation: Add hands-on evidence to top 10 roundups or reframe as research roundups.

findings.title: No author photo; credential mismatch
findings.description: Unchanged — About page has no author photo; 'crime novelist' vs '15 years building signal chains'.
findings.recommendation: Add real author photo; reconcile audio credentials.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Brand titles fixed across all pages (site title set)
Meta descriptions present and well-sized; review posts well-optimised

findings.title: Multiple H1 on landing/archive templates
findings.description: Homepage + some landing templates still emit 2 H1.

findings.title: Thin category titles + image alt
findings.description: Archive titles now carry the brand but remain generic; some images lack alt.
findings.recommendation: Descriptive category titles; add alt text.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: WebSite.name set; Organization node (logo + publishingPrinciples); publisher linked
ItemList + Product + Offer with live prices on roundups (price == on-page value)

findings.title: Minor residual schema items
findings.description: Article.keywords is a comma-joined string; one post missing dateModified; homepage ImageObject still hotlinks Unsplash.
findings.recommendation: Array keywords; ensure dateModified; self-host homepage image.

findings.title: No FAQPage on Q&A sections
findings.description: FAQ rich result retired May 2026; markup still aids AI citation.

findings.title: HTML uncacheable at CDN (DYNAMIC)
findings.description: AAWP aawp-country cookie still forces DYNAMIC; ~400ms TTFB.
findings.recommendation: Strip/ignore the cookie at the CDN/cache layer (Hostinger).

findings.title: Hotlinked Unsplash LCP + no WebP + missing dimensions
findings.description: 14 Unsplash hotlinks, 0 WebP, 13 imgs without width/height.
findings.recommendation: Self-host + WebP, set dimensions, fetchpriority/preload LCP.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: Brand now nameable by AI (WebSite.name + Organization); product structured data added
All AI crawlers allowed; strong product-entity anchors

findings.title: No comparison tables
findings.description: 0 <table> on 'vs'/'best' pages; AI Overviews/Perplexity favour tabular comparisons.
findings.recommendation: Add spec comparison tables to vs posts.

findings.title: No llms.txt; no Quick-Answer blocks
findings.description: /llms.txt still 404; paragraphs short, no TL;DR blocks.
findings.recommendation: Publish llms.txt; add 80-150 word answer blocks under H1.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Logo dimensioned; post featured images self-hosted

findings.title: Hotlinked stock, no WebP, missing dimensions
findings.recommendation: Self-host originals, WebP/AVIF, explicit dimensions, alt text.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Site title/schema, tag bloat, duplicate redirects, security headers, Organization/Person/ItemList schema — all applied & verified.

phases.name: Phase 2: Performance (host)
items: Self-host + WebP images, set dimensions, fetchpriority/preload LCP.

phases.name: Phase 3: Editorial E-E-A-T
items: First-hand testing evidence + author photo on top 10 roundups.

phases.name: Phase 4: Cleanup & Measure
items: Single homepage H1; llms.txt; author archive; 3 year-slug duplicates; 42 empty categories.
Track GSC Pages report for indexation/redirect uptake over 2-4 weeks.
